title: Change Classification Matrix — Delta Review Routing
purpose: Defines the complete change-to-review routing matrix. Every possible field-level change is mapped to its required review scope, board assignment, and estimated effort. Used by the Delta Review Engine to determine which items can skip re-review and which require full re-verification.

CONTENT_CHANGE.description: Any change to learner-facing content fields (Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong). These fields directly affect what the learner sees.

FULL_CONTENT.risk: Answer-key validity potentially affected. Distractor analysis invalidated. Blueprint alignment may have shifted.

METADATA_CHANGE.description: Changes to metadata fields that affect psychometric quality, blueprint alignment, and governance state — but not answer-key correctness.
METADATA_CHANGE.routing: Quality Board B — psychometric + blueprint review only. No technical re-verification.
METADATA_CHANGE.risk: No learner-facing correctness impact. Psychometric quality may shift.
examples: Blueprint LOSTag updated to align with IMA CSO revision

PRESENTATION_CHANGE.description: Changes that affect display but not content or metadata. Typo fixes, whitespace normalization, encoding corrections.
PRESENTATION_CHANGE.routing: No review required. Governance Board logs the change.
PRESENTATION_CHANGE.risk: Zero correctness impact. Zero educational impact.

CERTIFICATION_CHANGE.description: Changes to governance state fields only. No content, metadata, or presentation changed.
CERTIFICATION_CHANGE.routing: Governance Board — state transition validation only. No board review.
CERTIFICATION_CHANGE.risk: Zero correctness impact. Governance hygiene only.

effort_calibration.baseline_v1: 80% of items re-reviewed without change. Average 5-7 min/item across all boards.
effort_calibration.projected_v2: 20% of items re-reviewed. 77% reduction in review effort per wave.
effort_calibration.comparison: v1: 100 items × 6 min = 600 min. v2: 61 min. Savings: 539 min (−90%).

implementation_notes.field_hash_diff: When content_hash differs, compare per-field hashes (from field_hashes manifest in registry entry) to identify exactly which fields changed. This enables precise change classification rather than 'content changed → full review' catch-all.
implementation_notes.change_aggregation: Multiple simultaneous field changes are aggregated. If both Stem and EW_A changed → FULL_CONTENT takes precedence over EXPLANATION_CHANGE. The most-restrictive classification wins.
implementation_notes.delta_ledger_append: Every content or metadata change produces a DELTA_LEDGER entry recording old hash → new hash for each field. Enables field-level auditing and rollback capability.
